name: second_scream
notes: The answering scream: same band and grammar as scream but hoarser: thinner, more broken waveform, one echo, a little less mire thrown up, more ragged tears streaming back. Facing +x, exported in place (12 frames @ 12 fps, seamless loop). Feet anchor: ground is canvas row 67; the front's leading edge is at canvas x 99; place that point on the ring's position.
